jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Specialist
jobs.description: Gopuff is seeking a self-starter to join our P&C, Recruiting team in Philadelphia, PA.  As a Recruiting Operations Specialist, you will assist the team with moving candidates through the talent pipeline to build out Field teams as the company continues to expand! You will be responsible for a variety of administrative recruiting tasks to include, job reconciliations, offer tracking, onboarding management, I-9 compliance and more. Gopuff’s Talent Acquisition department is a close-knit team that will provide you with the tools and resources you need to grow and develop your skills.

jobs.title: Regional Manager I
jobs.description: Gopuff is seeking a Regional Manager I to join the operations team. We are looking for a self-starting and entrepreneurial strong leader; to lead locations across the United States. The Regional Manager role is an intense and fast-paced role within Gopuff that requires drive, grit, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. In this role, you will lead a team of General Managers. Ultimately, the success of the territory rests on your shoulders and is determined by your ability to execute and effectively lead a team that is hyper-focused on delivering a perfect experience for our customers.
